name: Travel Time
description: Street-mode isochrone polygons and estimated MOTIS transit reachability bands. Transit responses carry their actual runtime attribution separately.

valhalla.purpose: Visualize walking, cycling, and driving travel-time reachability from a point (street isochrone polygons only)
valhalla.dataSent: Center coordinates (latitude, longitude), travel mode, contour time thresholds in minutes
valhalla.dataReceived: GeoJSON isochrone polygons showing reachable area within specified time/distance thresholds
